sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Hallo,

Since I haven't heard back from you, I assume the deal is off. We are withdrawing from this negotiation. We need to keep our machines running, maybe next time.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

Dear partner,

We have not received a reply to our previous message and hope everything is well on your side. 

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We maintain our offer of a price of €16.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. For your planning, our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please let us know if a short meeting would help to align our positions. As an eager partner, we remain fully committed to working together and look forward to your feedback.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Dear partner,

As we have not received a response to our previous proposal, we are now submitting our final offer. This is our letztes Angebot, so please decide on how you would like to proceed.

We are holding our price of €16.90 for DAP delivery, 35-day lead time, and 60-day payment terms. To confirm the exact details of our offer, we are proposing a price of €16.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We hope this meets your requirements and look forward to your positive decision. We remain fully eager to win your business and build a strong partnership.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We have carefully reviewed your counter-offer; however, the requested DAP delivery and 35-day lead time introduce substantial additional costs compared to our initial EXW proposal.
As we operate with strict cash flow management, we must request to keep the payment terms at 45 days net instead of the proposed 60 days.
Accommodating your delivery and lead time requirements under 45-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €16.80 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
